cells.gaps: Law No. 1/03 of 10 March 2026 sets an adequacy condition and allows transfers with safeguards, but no source gives its date of commencement, so the routes are not shown in force. No ratification of the Malabo Convention has been found.
cells.note: Burundi Times says Article 15 of the 2026 law requires adequate protection in the receiving country [BDI-003], which answers question 1 yes. The law has been promulgated and no source found says it has taken effect, so question 2 is not shown for a rule in force and the stage is 2.
